name: What safety precautions do you take during feces cleanup?

mainEntity.name: What safety precautions do you take during feces cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: During feces cleanup, our technicians adhere to strict safety protocols to protect themselves and prevent cross-contamination. This includes wearing full personal protective equipment (PPE), such as hazmat suits, respirators, gloves, and eye protection. We establish containment zones to prevent the spread of contaminants and use medical-grade disinfectants. All contaminated waste is double-bagged and disposed of as biohazardous material in accordance with local regulations, ensuring a safe and thorough cleanup.
acceptedAnswer.description: We use full PPE, establish containment zones, apply medical-grade disinfectants, and dispose of biohazardous waste according to regulations.
